findings.evidence: Preflight says "Stop at the first row that matches", but the "components.schemas absent or empty | Continue" row precedes the catch-all unsupported-version rejection. An input with openapi: 3.2.0, paths: {}, and no components therefore reaches Continue instead of the required version stop.
findings.fix: Validate that the version is 3.0.x before any Continue branch. Then check references and schema availability separately, so absent components cannot bypass rejection of unsupported versions.

findings.evidence: Validation hardcodes "grep types/api.ts" and "npx tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 types/api.ts", although the workflow first selects the repository's existing API-types location. For an existing destination such as src/generated/api-types.ts, these commands inspect the wrong path; the excluded-file fallback is also unspecified.
findings.fix: Use the destination selected during emission in every validation command and check its resolved path against --listFilesOnly output. If the repository tsconfig excludes that file, validate it with a temporary config extending the repository config and explicitly including the destination; retain the documented standalone fallback when no repository config exists.
